Title: Enkidu, the Noah & Fast Hands / Shackles of Enkidu

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Since Enkidu can't have equipment, he can't steal equipment.
For the same reason, you can't put equipment on him (such as Shackles of Enkidu).

Generally speaking, you can't do illegal things or things that would result in an illegal situation voluntarily.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Perhaps this means that Wooden stake and Rowan ring cannot sent Enkidu to torpor?
> Because after Enkidu leave torpor him be controled this equipment.
>
You can strike with a Rowan ring, and send Enkidu to torpor, but then the ring is burned as it cannot be moved to Enkidu.

groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/rowan$20ring$20beast/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/fbVv76tOiN0/ICZ-5dSMc4AJ

> LSJ wrote:
> >>And, if Tariq rushes Beast, plays some funky stuff, then slaps with
> >>the Rowan Ring
> >>
> >>a) Strike declared illegal
> >>b) Strike OK, but ring is burned, and has no effect
> >>c) Strike OK, ring is burned, but it's text triggers first (sending
> >>Beast to torpor)
> >
> > C. Card text "send the opposing vampire in torpor" applies. But when "this
> > card is transfered to the opposing vampire", it burns.
> Correct.
>
The difference between the Shackles and the Rowan Ring is that the former is an effect to move equipment (illegal on Enkidu), the later is a strike to send to torpor (legal on Enkidu) with a side-effect that happens only if the strike is successful.

> LSJ wrote:
> The real difference is that Kiss of Ra has an explicit restriction
> prohibiting its use, whereas Wstake has an additional effect that
> occurs only when certain conditions are met. When those conditions
> are met, the additional effect is not optional. And, since it
> is not allowable, the card is burned.
>
(replace Wooden Stake with Rowan Ring)

Name: Rowan Ring
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Unique melee weapon.
Strike: Send the opposing vampire to torpor. This card is transferred to that vampire, and he or she doesn't untap as normal during the untap phase as long as he or she remains in torpor.

Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> well it is now clear,rowan and stake can use against enkidu and beast to sent both to torpor,and after strike resolve both be sent to torpor and both free to untap because rowan and stake be burned after sent them to torpor.

No, they are not free to untap - the 'do not untap' effect is independent of the 'transfer equipment' effect.

> 1 interesting question:what hapen if oposing vampire after strike resolve play amaranth?
> does rowan and stake be burned or oposing vampire take this weapon?
>
The card effects resolve atomically, so when amaranth is played the weapon has already been transfered and burned.
